JUDGMENT:( p er Hon 'b le Th e Act in g Ch ief Ju st ice Sr i Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i)
 Petitioner responded to the advertisement
issued for the post of Assistant Professor (Botany) in
Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University against
the vacancy reserved for Visually I m paired candidate.
Since he was not called for interview, therefore, he
approached this Court seeking the following relief: -
"1. I ssue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandam us directing the Respondent No.2 to allow the
petitioner to appear for the interview scheduled on 10-
06-2023."
2. On 09.06.2023, Co-ordinate Bench passed
interim order in favour of petitioner directing the
University to perm it the petitioner to participate in the

2024:UHC:7699-DB
interview process, and his candidature shall be
considered both against the general category as well as
the post earm arked for visually impaired person.
3. Thereafter, the said interim order was
m odified on 21.08.2023, and respondent no.2-
University was permitted to proceed with the selection
process for the unreserved category post. However, it
was provided that one post of Assistant Professor
(Botany) shall be kept reserved for accomm odating the
petitioner, in case the petitioner succeeds.
4. I n com pliance of order dated 21.08.2023, the
University has proceeded with the selection process,
and result of selection was placed before this Court in a
sealed cover, which was opened in the presence of
learned counsel for the parties.
5. Perusal of the result indicates that only two
candidates participated in the interview, and the
Selection Com mittee has observed that none of those
two candidates was found suitable.
6. Dr. Gupta, learned counsel for the University
submits that since none of those two candidates was
found suitable, therefore, vacancy in question, shall be
re-advertised, and petitioner may apply as and when

2024:UHC:7699-DB
the post is re-advertised.
7. I n view of the above, nothing survives in this
writ petition. Petitioner's candidature has been
considered, and the duly constituted Selection
Committee has not found any candidate suitable,
therefore, there is no scope of interference in the
present writ petition.
8. The writ petition fails, and is accordingly,
dismissed.
9. Pending application, if any, also stands
disposed of.
10. The result placed before this Court in a
sealed cover has been returned to Dr. Gupta, learned
counsel for the University.
''
( MANOJ KUMAR TI W ARI , A.C.J.)
